# App Bridge 类型 {#app-bridge-types}

App Bridge 各页面用到的类型，以及它们引用的所有类型，均来自 [`@shopify/app-bridge-types`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@shopify/app-bridge-types) 0.7.4。`polaris-vue-elements/app-bridge` 重新导出该包所导出的类型。说明是 Shopify 自己的 JSDoc，保留英文。

## ShopifyGlobal 与 API {#apis}

### `AppApi` {#appapi}

| 成员 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `extensions()` | <code v-pre>() =&gt; Promise&lt;<a href="#extensioninfo">ExtensionInfo</a>[]&gt;</code> | The list of extensions from the current app. |

用于： [useAppBridge()](/zh/app-bridge/use-app-bridge), [`ShopifyGlobal`](#shopifyglobal)

### `AppBridgeConfig` {#appbridgeconfig}

| 成员 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `apiKey` | <code v-pre>string</code> | The client ID (also known as the API key) for your application, found in the Shopify Partner Dashboard under your app's settings.<br><br>You must provide this value using a `<meta name="shopify-api-key">` tag. |
| `appOrigins?` | <code v-pre>string[]</code> | An allowlist of origins that your app can send authenticated fetch requests to.<br><br>Set this property if your app needs to make authenticated requests to a domain other than your app's origin. Requests to your app's own domain (and its subdomains) are automatically allowed.<br><br>Each value must be an origin in the format `scheme://hostname` or `scheme://hostname:port` (for example, `'https://example.com'` or `'https://example.com:8443'`). |
| `debug?` | <code v-pre><a href="#debugoptions">DebugOptions</a></code> | Configuration for enabling Web Vitals performance logging.<br><br>Use this property during development for identifying performance issues. |
| `disabledFeatures?` | <code v-pre>string[]</code> | An array of App Bridge feature names to disable in your app.<br><br>Supported values:<br>- `'fetch'` — Disables App Bridge's automatic fetch interceptor, which adds authentication headers to requests to the Shopify Admin API.<br>- `'auto-redirect'` — Disables automatic redirection when the app is loaded outside of the Shopify Admin. |
| `experimentalFeatures?` | <code v-pre>string[]</code> | The experimental features to enable in your app.<br><br>This allows app developers to opt-in to experiement features. |
| `host?` | <code v-pre>string</code> | The base64-encoded host of the shop that's embedding your app. When decoded, the value has the format `admin.shopify.com/store/{shop-name}`.<br><br>This property is automatically set by the host environment. |
| `locale?` | <code v-pre>string</code> | The locale of the admin user viewing your app, as an IETF BCP 47 language tag (for example, `'en-US'`, `'fr-FR'`, `'ja-JP'`).<br><br>This reflects the language the merchant has chosen for the Shopify admin, not the shop's customer-facing locale.<br><br>This property is automatically set by the host environment. 默认值： `'en-US'` |
| `shop?` | <code v-pre>string</code> | The permanent `.myshopify.com` domain of the shop that's embedding your app (for example, `'my-store.myshopify.com'`). This is always the Shopify-assigned domain, not a custom domain.<br><br>This property is automatically set by the host environment. |

用于： [useAppBridge()](/zh/app-bridge/use-app-bridge), [`ShopifyGlobal`](#shopifyglobal)

Required scopes cannot be revoked. |

| 成员 | 类型 | 说明 |

| `isEnabled()` | <code v-pre>() =&gt; Promise&lt;boolean&gt;</code> | Checks whether Sidekick is available to the app on this store. Call it before showing a launch entry point. |

A string is shorthand for `{message}`. Call it from a merchant action, such as a button click. Shopify screens the prompt first and rejects with an error whose message starts with `sidekick.launch:` when it refuses to send it. |

## 元素与属性 {#elements-and-attributes}

### `SAppWindowAttributes` {#sappwindowattributes}

Attributes for the app window element. This element displays a fullscreen modal window in the Shopify admin.

导入： `import type { SAppWindowAttributes } from 'polaris-vue-elements/app-bridge'`

| 成员 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id?` | <code v-pre>string</code> | A unique identifier you assign to the app window element. Used when connecting buttons via `commandFor` or accessing the element with `document.getElementById()`. Choose a descriptive name like `"settings-window"` or `"edit-modal"`. |
| `src` | <code v-pre>string</code> | The URL of the content to display within the app window. Must point to a route within your app that renders the window content. The URL is loaded in an iframe when the window opens. Commonly used for multi-step workflows, bulk editors, or detailed views that need full-screen space. |

用于： [AppWindow](/zh/app-bridge/app-window)

### `UIModalElement` {#uimodalelement}

在 `declare global` 中声明，因此无需导入即可使用。

继承： <code v-pre>Omit&lt;HTMLElement, "addEventListener" &#124; "removeEventListener"&gt;</code>, <code v-pre>Required&lt;Omit&lt;<a href="#_uimodalelement">_UIModalElement</a>, "content" &#124; "src" &#124; "contentWindow"&gt;&gt;</code>, <code v-pre>Pick&lt;<a href="#_uimodalelement">_UIModalElement</a>, "content" &#124; "src" &#124; "contentWindow"&gt;</code>

用于： [Modal](/zh/app-bridge/modal)

### `_UIModalElement` {#_uimodalelement}

| 成员 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `variant?` | <code v-pre>"small" &#124; "base" &#124; "large" &#124; "max"</code> | A getter/setter that is used to set modal variant. |
| `content?` | <code v-pre>HTMLElement</code> | A getter/setter that is used to get the DOM content of the modal element and update the content after the modal has been opened. |
| `src?` | <code v-pre>string</code> | A getter/setter that is used to set modal src. |
| `readonly contentWindow?` | <code v-pre>Window &#124; null</code> | A getter that is used to get the Window object of the modal iframe when the modal is used with a `src` attribute. This can only be accessed when the modal is open, so it is recommended to use `await modal.show()` before accessing this property. |
| `show?()` | <code v-pre>() =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</code> | Shows the modal element |
| `hide?()` | <code v-pre>() =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</code> | Hides the modal element |
| `toggle?()` | <code v-pre>() =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;</code> | Toggles the modal element between the showing and hidden states |
| `addEventListener?()` | <code v-pre>(type: "show" &#124; "hide", listener: EventListenerOrEventListenerObject) =&gt; void</code> | Add 'show' \| 'hide' event listeners. |
| `removeEventListener?()` | <code v-pre>(type: "show" &#124; "hide", listener: EventListenerOrEventListenerObject) =&gt; void</code> | Remove 'show' \| 'hide' event listeners. |

用于： [`UIModalElement`](#uimodalelement)

### `PickerItem` {#pickeritem}

| 成员 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | <code v-pre>string</code> | The unique identifier for this item. This ID is returned in the selection array when the merchant selects this item. Use an ID that helps you identify the item in your system (for example, template IDs, review IDs, or custom option keys). |
| `heading` | <code v-pre>string</code> | The primary text displayed in the first column. This is typically the item's name or title and is the most prominent text in the row. |
| `data?` | <code v-pre><a href="#datapoint">DataPoint</a>[]</code> | Additional data displayed in subsequent columns after the heading. Each value appears in its own column, and the order must match the `headers` array. For example, if headers are `["Price", "Status"]`, then data would be `[19.99, "Active"]`. |
| `disabled?` | <code v-pre>boolean</code> | Whether the item can be selected. When `true`, the item is disabled and can't be selected. Disabled items appear grayed out. Use this for items that are unavailable or don't meet selection criteria. 默认值： `false` |
| `selected?` | <code v-pre>boolean</code> | Whether the item is preselected when the picker opens. When `true`, the item appears selected by default. Merchants can still deselect preselected items. Use this to show current selections or suggest default choices. |
| `badges?` | <code v-pre><a href="#badge">Badge</a>[]</code> | Status or context badges displayed next to the heading in the first column. Use badges to highlight item state, completion status, or other important attributes (for example, "Draft", "Published", "Incomplete"). |
| `thumbnail?` | <code v-pre>{ url: string; }</code> | A small preview image or icon displayed at the start of the row. Thumbnails help merchants visually identify items at a glance. Provide a URL to the image file. |

用于： [`PickerOptions`](#pickeroptions)

### `PickerOptions` {#pickeroptions}

| 成员 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` | <code v-pre>string</code> | The heading displayed at the top of the picker modal. Use a clear, descriptive title that tells merchants what they're selecting. |
| `multiple?` | <code v-pre>boolean &#124; number</code> | The selection mode for the picker. Pass `true` to allow unlimited selections, `false` for single-item selection only, or a number to set a maximum selection limit (for example, `3` allows up to three items). 默认值： `false` |
| `headers?` | <code v-pre><a href="#header">Header</a>[]</code> | The column headers for the picker table. Define headers to label and organize the data columns displayed for each item. The header order determines the column layout. |
| `items` | <code v-pre><a href="#pickeritem">PickerItem</a>[]</code> | The list of items that merchants can select from. Each item appears as a row in the picker table. |

用于： [`PickerApi`](#pickerapi)

### `ResourcePickerOptions` {#resourcepickeroptions}

类型参数： <code v-pre>ResourceType extends keyof <a href="#resourcetypes">ResourceTypes</a> = keyof <a href="#resourcetypes">ResourceTypes</a></code>

| 成员 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | <code v-pre>ResourceType</code> | The type of Shopify resource to select: `'product'` for products, `'variant'` for specific product variants, or `'collection'` for collections. This determines what appears in the picker and what data structure is returned. |
| `action?` | <code v-pre>"add" &#124; "select"</code> | The action verb that appears in the title as the primary action of the resource picker. "Add" prompts merchants that they are appending to an existing list, while "select" they'll choose a resource for a specific purpose or replacing selections. 默认值： `'add'` |
| `filter?` | <code v-pre><a href="#filters">Filters</a></code> | Filtering options that control which resources appear in the resourcepicker. Use filters to restrict resources by publication status, include or exclude variants, or apply custom search criteria. This helps merchants find relevant items faster. |
| `multiple?` | <code v-pre>boolean &#124; number</code> | Whether to allow selecting multiple items of a specific type. If a number is provided, limit selections to that maximum. When `type` is `'product'`, merchants can still select multiple variants from a single product even when `multiple` is `false`. 默认值： `false` |
| `query?` | <code v-pre>string</code> | Initial GraphQL search query for filtering resources available in the resource picker. See [search syntax](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/usage/search-syntax) for more information. This is displayed in the search bar when the picker is opened and can be edited by users. For most use cases, you should use the `filter.query` option instead which doesn't show the query in the UI. 默认值： `''` |
| `selectionIds?` | <code v-pre><a href="#baseresource">BaseResource</a>[]</code> | Resources that should be preselected when the picker is opened. Use this for edit workflows to show what products are already in a bundle, collection, or promotional set. Merchants can see current selections and modify them before confirming. 默认值： `[]` |

用于： [`ResourcePickerApi`](#resourcepickerapi)
